field.label: Enable
field.help: Send Unbound's root-zone queries through the gateway group's best member to that member's resolver (its row under Per-member resolvers, else the Default resolver below), and fall back to Unbound's own forwarders when no member is usable. Off returns Unbound to its own forwarders and removes the resolvers' routes.

field.label: Dry run
field.help: Decide and log only: Unbound's forwarders and the resolvers' routes are left alone. The block and pass rules are still loaded. A fail-closed view file left by a real run is deleted only once dry run is off.

field.label: Gateway group
field.help: The saved gateway group, all of one address family, whose members are the tunnels to the resolver. Every member must be monitored.

field.label: Default resolver
field.help: The resolver's address inside the tunnels, used by every member without its own below. IPv4 or IPv6.

field.label: Failback delay (seconds)
field.help: How long a better member must stay usable before Unbound returns to it. Use at least the longest monitor period of the members.

field.label: Fall back to Unbound's own forwarders
field.help: While no member is usable, Unbound uses its own forwarders (Query Forwarding or DNS over TLS) for every client except those set to fail closed below. Off: every client gets REFUSED instead. The firewall's own lookups always fall back. Use with care.

field.label: Fail closed on
field.help: Clients on these interfaces get REFUSED for internet names while no member is usable; local names still resolve. A client querying from an IPv6 link-local address is not covered. A point-to-point interface (a /32 or /128 address) contributes only its own address; list its peers under Fail closed for networks.

field.label: Fail closed for networks
field.help: Source networks routed to the firewall whose clients use it for DNS, such as a Tailscale tailnet (100.64.0.0/10 and fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48). They get REFUSED for internet names while no member is usable; local names still resolve. A tailnet only fails closed if the firewall is its only global nameserver.

field.label: Notify on switch
field.help: POST each switch between a member and the fallback to the URL below as JSON, for example to a Home Assistant webhook.

field.label: Notify URL
field.help: The http or https URL that receives each switch.
